name: LD2460 Sensor
description: The `ld2460` component allows you to use the Hi-Link HLK-LD2460 24GHz 2T4R millimeter-wave radar module with ESPHome. The module is made by [Hi-Link](https://www.hlktech.net/) (vendor website).

config_entries.label: UART ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the [UART Component](https://esphome.io/components/uart/) to use. Required if multiple UARTs are configured.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for this LD2460 component.
